queries: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC, i.invoice_number LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each invoice ratio uses only line items with both costs present. Line-item count includes every row for the invoice. An average ratio of zero makes the relative figure missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Ignore missing values separately in each cost column, so a line item may contribute to one sum but not the other.

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is the sum of product costs divided by the sum of total costs. A line contributes to those sums only when both costs are present; the line-item count includes every row.

alternatives.interpretation: The invoice's ratio is the average of its individual line-item ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios), results AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, relative_ratio FROM results ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each invoice ratio divides its summed product costs by its summed total costs. Each SUM independently ignores NULL values; the overall average gives each invoice with a defined ratio equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: Use only line items where both costs are present when calculating each invoice ratio, while still counting every line item.
